Chance on G cells: 0.167 (n=6). Classes come from the preregistered rule (`exp1/analyze.py`; the rule is unchanged, and bootstrap seeds are now fixed per data so CIs are reproducible). CIs: trial bootstrap, 2,000 resamples.
† nf4: the preregistered quantisation control failed its tolerance (absolute G accuracy biased low by ~0.04; per-query predictions unstable). Classes and the t4−scramble contrast are unchanged at 1.7B (exp2/PREREGISTRATION_ADDENDUM.md).
Trained networks: class R means only "acc_L below threshold"; every network also fails the recall (leak) control, so it neither recalls nor infers at sparse cues. Learner C (added post hoc, 2026-10-09) answers with the word least represented in the revealed cue; A1, A2, A4, G4 and I4 match it to within 0.007 accuracy (exp3/heur/count_heuristic.md). P4 is "not learned" under the Exp-3 preregistered learning-failure rule and is excluded from method validation.
